title: AI Research Associate Roadmap
summary: A four-year engineering path focused on mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, research methodology, experimentation, scientific writing, and progression toward research-oriented AI roles.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026–2030 four-year B.Tech/B.E. programme. The first two years establish mathematics, programming and ML foundations; Years 3–4 emphasize research projects, papers, experimentation, internships and preparation for research-oriented postgraduate study.

blocks.label: 4-year honours variant
blocks.text: Use the additional honours year for a longer research project, research internship, publication-quality work or advanced coursework rather than simply accumulating certificates.
Specialisation

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Progress from reproducing published methods to designing experiments and identifying research questions. Over time, combine a deep research specialisation with strong engineering and statistical skills so that research can be translated into reproducible systems.

blocks.label: PMRF
blocks.text: Intended for eligible PhD candidates at IIT, IISc, NIT, IISER or IIEST routes after a qualifying four-year UG degree or integrated M.Tech/M.Sc. A regular-college BCA student is not eligible directly; this roadmap is for B.Tech/B.E., but institutional and programme conditions still need checking.

PhD routes

Research careers increasingly require the ability to identify meaningful research questions, design rigorous experiments, evaluate evidence and communicate results. Maintain a deep specialisation while developing enough systems and engineering knowledge to turn research ideas into reproducible implementations.
